    for i in range(len(strut_bodies) - 1):
        current_sx, current_strut = strut_bodies[i]
        next_sx, next_strut = strut_bodies[i+1]
        
        # Calculate brace position and angle
        brace_x = (current_sx + next_sx) / 2
        brace_y = ground_top + strut_h/2 + 0.5
        brace_angle = math.atan((deck_cy - ground_top)/2)
        
        # Create diagonal brace
        brace = sandbox.add_beam(
            x=brace_x, y=brace_y,
            width=0.2, height=0.2,
            angle=brace_angle,
            density=0.15
        )
        
        # Connect brace to current and next strut with pivot joints
        sandbox.add_joint(brace, current_strut, (brace_x, brace_y), type="pivot")
        sandbox.add_joint(brace, next_strut, (brace_x, brace_y), type="pivot")
    
    # Connect spans to deck with pivot joints
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, deck_left, (6.0, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_left, deck_right, (10.0, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    sandbox.add_joint(deck_right, right_span, (14.0, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    
    # Ensure spans connect to struts
    sandbox.add_joint(left_span, strut_bodies[0][1], (6.0, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    sandbox.add_joint(right_span, strut_bodies[-1][1], (14.0, deck_cy), type="pivot")
    
    return deck_left
